items.q: What makes MiniMax M3 different on paper?
items.a: Multimodal foundation model: text, image, **video** input; **1M** context (M2.7: **205K**). MiniMax claims it beats GPT 5.5 on SWE-Bench Pro — creator calls that **bench-maxing** on contaminated benchmarks.

items.q: How big was the real coding jump from M2.7?
items.a: +**15** pts Terminal Bench 2.1, but only **+0.6** SWE-Bench Verified and **+2.8** SWE-Bench Pro — **not a massive leap**. Launch discount makes input ~same as M2.7 (**$0.26/M** in) before a **100% price increase** when it ends.

items.q: What broke in game and Remotion tests?
items.a: Arena Ops FPS: player **glitches into floor** (unplayable). Remotion Vibecademy: **134K tokens** → mostly blank screen; needed a **second shot**; still subpar vs Opus 4.8 one-shot.

items.q: What happened on BridgeVoice production tasks?
items.a: Auto-hide widget: toggling off **doesn't restore the pill**. Sound-effect task **broke push-to-talk** entirely despite not touching PTT logic — classic **attention-to-detail** failure.

items.q: Could video input help debug in OpenCode?
items.a: Creator recorded a **5–10s** FPS glitch clip, but OpenCode's read tool only supports images/PDFs — **could not ingest MP4** (likely tooling limit, not the model). Video modality still a unique hook vs Opus/GPT.

items.q: How did M3 score on UI and refactoring?
items.a: UI: failed **8/12** visual designs. Refactoring: **worst tier** (M2.5/M2.7/M3 cluster at bottom). Debugging mid-pack (**#14**); BS **#10** (better than Opus 4.7).
Whole session **$4.09** — among cheapest — but ~**23 tok/s** with **3.43s** OpenRouter latency: "too slow." Cheap + unreliable.

items.q: Will BridgeMind use M3 personally or in Hermes agents?
items.a: **No stamp of approval.** Way off frontier — cost-tier peer with Kimi K2.6 / GLM 5.1, not Opus 4.8 / GPT 5.5. GPT plan unlimited usage beats **cheap broken output**. "You get what you pay for."
